en.io: Inputs are transcripts, optional project/team context, reference artifacts, and external draft minutes. Outputs are Markdown minutes, intermediate complete-pass drafts, diagrams, retrieval-test claims, and review statistics.
en.boundary: Structures transcript evidence rather than correcting ASR. Speaker identity must not be silently inferred; source-side labeling or user confirmation is preferred. Drafts require human review, and claims from external drafts must be verified against the transcript.
dependencies: Readable transcript and optional context files
Multiple isolated agent passes for the specified full workflow
Optional transcript-fixer and document conversion tools
scenarios: Create minutes with decisions, action items, discussion, open questions, and supporting quotes.
Merge several minutes drafts without losing unique content.
Audit existing notes against a transcript or identify anonymous speakers with user-confirmed mappings.

zh.io: 输入为会议转写、可选项目/团队上下文、参考材料和外部纪要草稿；输出为 Markdown 纪要、多轮中间稿、图表、检索自测声明及审查统计。
zh.boundary: 用于组织转写证据，不负责纠正 ASR。不得静默猜测说话人身份，应优先使用源平台标注或用户确认。产物是需人工审阅的草稿，外部版本中的内容必须回到原转写核验。
dependencies: 可读取的转写和可选上下文文件
完整流程要求的多次隔离代理生成
Markdown 与 Mermaid 渲染能力
可选的 transcript-fixer 和文档转换工具
scenarios: 生成包含决策、行动项、讨论、开放问题和原文引述的会议纪要。
合并多份纪要版本并保留各版本独有内容。
对照原始转写审查现有纪要，或在用户确认下识别匿名说话人。
